name: Basmisanil
summary: Basmisanil is a highly selective inverse agonist/negative allosteric modulator of α5 subunit-containing GABAA receptors which is under development by Roche for the treatment of cognitive impairment associated with Down syndrome. As of June 2016, it is no longer studied for this purpose. It underwent a clinical trial for cognitive impairment in patients with schizophrenia.

pharmacology.text: Basmisanil (INN; developmental codes RG-1662 and RO5186582) is a highly selective inverse agonist/negative allosteric modulator of α5 subunit-containing GABAA receptors which is under development by Roche for the treatment of cognitive impairment associated with Down syndrome.

uses.text: Basmisanil (INN; developmental codes RG-1662 and RO5186582) is a highly selective inverse agonist/negative allosteric modulator of α5 subunit-containing GABAA receptors which is under development by Roche for the treatment of cognitive impairment associated with Down syndrome. As of June 2016, it is no longer studied for this purpose.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects were generally mild. It did not meet its goals in studies for Down syndrome, and it has not been marketed, so its long-term effects are not known.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應普遍輕微。它在唐氏症的研究中未達目標，也未曾上市，因此長期影響不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应普遍轻微。它在唐氏症的研究中未达目标，也未曾上市，因此长期影响不明。

fact.en: It turns down only those GABA-A receptors that contain the alpha-5 part, which sit mostly in the hippocampus. The aim was to lift memory by easing one specific brake on it.
fact.zh: 它只調降含有 α5 次單元的 GABA-A 受體，而這些受體大多位於海馬體。其目標是透過放鬆某一個特定的煞車來提升記憶。
fact.zhHans: 它只调降含有 α5 次单元的 GABA-A 受体，而这些受体大多位于海马体。其目标是通过放松某一个特定的煞车来提升记忆。
